name: anthropic-quickstarts
test_cmd: (cd computer-use-demo && "$ENV/computer-use-demo/bin/python" -m pytest tests -p no:cacheprovider); r1=$?; (cd computer-use-best-practices && "$ENV/computer-use-best-practices/bin/python" -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --deselect tests/test_shell.py::test_bash_echo --deselect tests/test_shell.py::test_python_print --deselect tests/test_shell.py::test_output_truncated --deselect tests/test_editor.py::test_shell_shares_scratch_dir) && exit $r1
notes: Each setup command that runs uv sources scripts/env.sh itself so caches/Python installs stay in .tools. Baseline measured with cwd=$SRC=eval/work/base/<name> under a clean env (env -i HOME/PATH/LANG + test_env, RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset, no provider API keys) with outbound network denied via macOS sandbox-exec (loopback + unix sockets allowed); counts were identical on a from-scratch rebuild into eval/work/envs/<name>-check (since deleted). Monorepo; two Python subprojects are tested, each in its own venv under $ENV because their anthropic pins conflict (computer-use-demo: anthropic>=1.9,<2 -> 1.13.0; computer-use-best-practices: anthropic==0.93.0). $PY is therefore NOT used; test_cmd calls $ENV/<subproject>/bin/python explicitly. (1) computer-use-demo: the only subproject in CI (.github/workflows/tests.yaml pytest job: Python 3.11.6, pip install -r dev-requirements.txt, `pytest tests`): 73 passed. (2) computer-use-best-practices (not in CI; README `python -m pytest`, testpaths=tests): installs its uv-exported requirements.txt (darwin-only markers, fully pinned) + pytest>=8.0; 116 passed. It builds a real anthropic.Anthropic client over httpx.MockTransport (tests/test_loop_hosted.py) so it exercises client construction/headers, which is migration-relevant. Both on Python 3.11 (requires >=3.11). The two suites run sequentially; test_cmd runs the second even if the first fails and exits non-zero if either fails (rather than a plain `&&`), so counts stay complete; passed/failed/... are the sums of both pytest summaries. Deselections (4, best-practices only): tests/test_shell.py::test_bash_echo, ::test_python_print, ::test_output_truncated and tests/test_editor.py::test_shell_shares_scratch_dir. They run the tool's own `sandbox-exec` shell sandbox, which cannot nest inside an outer sandbox-exec (fails with 'sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted'); they pass when run unsandboxed and are unrelated to LLM calls, so they are deselected to keep counts identical with or without a sandboxed harness. Not included: browser-use-demo (has offline pytest suite but needs playwright/streamlit stack and is not in CI), agents/test_message_params.py (live-API script, not pytest-collected), Node apps. --exclude-newer 2026-10-13 pins resolution of computer-use-demo's unpinned deps.
